data.one_liner: A customizable star rating widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a star rating UI that supports full and half stars, customizable icons, and color options. It handles user interaction and exposes a callback for rating changes.
use_when: Collecting user feedback with star scales
Adding review components to product pages
avoid_when: Building complex rating systems with multiple criteria
Needing advanced animation or gesture handling beyond stars
strengths: Null safety and modern Dart support
weaknesses: No built-in animation or gesture customization beyond default
data.minimal_example:
StarRating(
  rating: 3.5,
  allowHalfRating: true,
  onRatingChanged: (rating) => setState(() => this.rating = rating),
)
